name: microsoft-365-defender
label: Microsoft 365 Defender
description: Microsoft 365 Defender For Endpoints is a unified platform for preventative protection, post-breach detection, automated investigation, and response. This connector facilitates the automated operations related to files, machines, IP, Domain, actor etc.

fields.title: Get Access Token
options: On behalf of User - Delegated Permission
fields.name: auth_type
fields.description: Select the method using which you will get authentication tokens used to access the Microsoft 365 Defender APIs. You can choose between On behalf of User – Delegate Permission or Without a User - Application Permission. For more information, see the Getting Access Tokens section.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set as True.

operations.title: Get Incidents List
operations.description: Retrieves a list of incidents along with their status for users to sort through and create an informed cybersecurity response. It exposes a collection of incidents that were flagged in your network, based on the time range, incident owner and other details that you have specified.

parameters.title: Last Updated Time
parameters.name: lastUpdateTime
parameters.tooltip: Specify the time when the incident was last updated.
parameters.description: Specify the time when the incident was last updated on the server.

parameters.title: Created Time
parameters.name: createdTime
parameters.tooltip: Specify time when incident was first created.
parameters.description: Specify the time when incident was first created.

parameters.title: Status
parameters.name: status
parameters.tooltip: Specify the current status of the incident.
parameters.description: Specifies the current status of the incident.

parameters.title: Assigned To
parameters.name: assignedTo
parameters.tooltip: Specify the owner of the incident
parameters.description: Specify the incident owner's email address.

parameters.title: Filter Query
parameters.name: query
parameters.tooltip: Specify the filter query to filter the results from Microsoft 365 Defender. You can apply the query on lastUpdateTime, createdTime, status, and assignedTo properties.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the query to filter results retrieved from Microsoft 365 Defender. For query syntax and other information, refer to https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/filter-query-parameter.

parameters.title: Offset
parameters.name: skip
parameters.tooltip: To skip the first n element based upon the value you specify in there
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the count of the first few records to skip while retrieving response from Defender Endpoint API.

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.name: top
parameters.tooltip: Maximum number of incidents that this operation should return, maximum is 100
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the maximum number of incidents that this operation should return from Microsoft 365 Defender. The maximum values it can return is 100.

parameters.name: get_all_records
parameters.title: Get All Records
parameters.tooltip: Select to retrieve all records present and ignore the parameters Offset and Limit. By default, this is selected, i.e. set to true.
parameters.description: Select to retrieve all records present and ignore the parameters Offset and Limit. By default, this is selected, i.e. set to true.

operations.title: Get Incident Details
operations.description: Retrieves the details of a specific incident based on the incident ID that you have specified.

parameters.title: Incident ID
parameters.name: id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique identifier that represents the incident to fetch its details.
parameters.description: Specify the unique identifier that represents the incident to fetch its details.

operations.title: Update Incident
operations.description: Updates the owner, status, comments, and other details of existing incidents based on the incident ID that you have specified.

parameters.title: Incident ID
parameters.name: id
parameters.tooltip: Unique identifier to represent the incident
parameters.description: Specify the unique identifier that represents the incident to update it.

parameters.title: Status
parameters.name: status
parameters.tooltip: Specify the status of the incident.
parameters.description: SSelect from drop-down the status with which to update the incident.

parameters.title: Assigned To
parameters.name: assignedTo
parameters.tooltip: Specify the owner of the incident.
parameters.description: Specify the incident owner's email address.

parameters.title: Classification
parameters.name: classification
parameters.tooltip: Select the classification of the incident.
parameters.description: Select from drop-down the specification of the incident:

TruePositive.title: Determination
TruePositive.name: determination
TruePositive.description: Specifies that the incident was a malicious activity.

Informational, expected activity.title: Determination
Informational, expected activity.name: determination
Informational, expected activity.description: Specifies that the activity related to the incident was expected. For example, a security test.

FalsePositive.title: Determination
FalsePositive.name: determination
FalsePositive.description: Specifies that the activity was non-malicious.

parameters.title: Tags
parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Specify a list of incident tags.
parameters.tooltip: Specify in csv format for custom tags associated with an incident

parameters.title: Comment
parameters.name: comment
parameters.tooltip: Specify the comment to be added to the incident.
parameters.description: Specify a comment to be added to the incident.

operations.title: Advanced Hunting
operations.description: Retrieves data from the past 30 days based on the query that you have specified.

parameters.title: Query
parameters.name: Query
parameters.tooltip: Query to examine the past 30 days of event data in Microsoft 365 Defender.
parameters.description: Specify a query to examine the past 30 days of event data in Microsoft 365 Defender. For more information on the queries, refer to Microsoft 365 Defender Advanced hunting.
